description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function named smarty_literal_compiler_param, which evaluates compiler parameters to determine if they are literals and returns their evaluated value or a default. It includes handling for parameter validation and exception throwing if the parameter is not a literal.

methods.name: smarty_literal_compiler_param
methods.description: Evaluates a compiler parameter, checking if it is a literal string and returning its value or a default, throwing an exception if not a literal.
